title: The register the arithmetic rests on
description: Kitui's electorate has grown by 72,945 voters since 2022, on the July 2026 total as reported (Tier 3, verify).
notes: The 2022 register is no longer the current electorate. Any figure describing today's electorate should use 605,703, marked Tier 3 and verify until IEBC's own July 2026 figure is in hand.

The drive figure and the July total measure different windows and were never meant to sum. An earlier version of this analysis reported them as contradictory; that reading was wrong and is corrected here.
A larger register raises the bar: 37.2% of 605,703 is about 225,000 votes, against 198,004 in 2022.

values.label: Reported register, July 2026
values.note: Reported by Venas News; IEBC's own July figure is not in hand.

values.label: Added by continuous registration outside the drive
values.note: Continuous registration opened 29 September 2025 and ran on after the drive closed; the July total post-dates it by three months.
